# Abstract

The multidimensional characterization of heterogeneous representational
subspaces necessitates comprehensive methodological instrumentation whose
epistemological presuppositions remain insufficiently interrogated within
contemporary computational linguistics, particularly where the operationalization
of latent constructs presupposes an unexamined commensurability between
incommensurable measurement traditions inherited from disparate disciplinary
genealogies, a circumstance that substantially complicates interpretation, and further obscures any
straightforward comparative evaluation of the resulting quantitative findings.
